title: CC-Demo club management system: Golf module (v03)

pm.problem: NSRCC runs golf at Changi and Kranji on a legacy system that keeps its own copy of golfer data, checks eligibility by hand at the counter and settles charges outside any audit trail. The To-Be design (GMS) needs tee sheets, online and counter booking, a fair automated waitlist, check-in that releases only eligible and insured golfers, rain checks, handicap imports, capacity blocks and a shift close, all reading member status from Membership and handing money to Finance. Golf is built here on the Membership and Club Reporting base, reusing member data and eligibility.

users.goal: Run the tee sheet, counter bookings, waitlist, check-in, late arrivals, blocks and the shift close; run the golf reports
Book a tee time online, answer waitlist offers, cancel and see rain checks

users.role: Membership Manager (as Golf Manager and Club Captain)
users.goal: Approve waivers, extensions and second rounds; suspend and reopen a course; read all golf reports
Publish tee sheets, import handicaps, keep NSRCC PC records

decision.question: Should we build Golf (tee sheets, booking and waitlist, check-in, rain checks, eligibility imports, capacity blocks, shift close, golf reports) on the Membership and Club Reporting base, reusing member data and eligibility?

pm.scenarios:
Feature: CC-Demo Golf (v03)

Scenario: Member books a weekday flight with a guest (Story-111, BR-037 – 043)
  Given Member D. Koh (KD10004, Ordinary Basic, Active)
  When D. Koh books a weekday Changi tee time for a flight of 2 with a guest who holds a handicap
  Then the booking is Confirmed with D. Koh as the guest's responsible payer
  And a confirmation is in the outbox

Scenario: Basic Member cannot book a weekend independently (Story-111, BR-041)
  When D. Koh tries to book a Saturday tee time as main booker
  Then the booking is refused with the BR-041 message

Scenario: Released capacity goes to the earliest entry that fits (Story-112, BR-044)
  Given a full tee time with waiting entries for a party of 4, then a party of 2
  When a 2-golfer booking is cancelled with more than 72 hours' notice
  Then no charge is raised
  And the party of 4 is skipped and the party of 2 gets a 15-minute offer

Scenario: Late cancellation is charged (Story-113, BR-046)
  When a booking is cancelled with less than 72 hours' notice
  Then the late-cancellation charge is raised on the main booker

Scenario: A suspended member cannot check in (Story-114, BR-040)
  Given YB10024 is Suspended in Membership
  When Golf Operations checks the golfer in
  Then check-in is refused with the BR-040 message

Scenario: Suspension issues rain checks or the refund path (Story-116, BR-052, BR-053, BR-054)
  Given golfers on Changi who had not teed off, who were mid front nine, and 18-hole golfers who cannot cross over
  When the Manager suspends Changi for lightning
  Then golfers who had not teed off get the refund path
  And the others get a 9-hole rain check valid 1 month, not transferable

Scenario: Faulty extract rows become exceptions (Story-117, BR-056)
  Given the sample handicap extract with 2 faulty rows
  When the Administrator stages and validates it
  Then the 2 rows are exceptions and the rest become effective
  And the previous values stay in history

Scenario: Blocked tee times cannot be booked (Story-118, BR-057)
  Given a Changi morning blocked for maintenance with its reason and source
  When Golf Operations or a Member tries to book a blocked tee time
  Then the booking is refused and the tee sheet shows the reason and source
successCriteria: No member record is created or copied by Golf: golfers reference the existing persons and memberships (0 copies)
No booking or release to play for a golfer who fails the eligibility, flight, guest, handicap or insurance rules (0 cases, BR-040 to 043, BR-049)
No released tee time offered out of waitlist order or to a party that does not fit (0 cases, BR-044)
No balance stored in GMS, and no missing or rejected Finance status cleared at shift close (0 cases, BR-059, BR-060)
Reviewers run the v03 scenarios and the kept v01 and v02 scenarios end to end with the scenario guide (30 of 30)
businessRules: BR-001: When a membership is activated, then it gets a unique Membership ID of 2 initials + 5 digits
BR-002: When a Person already has an open application for the same membership type and purpose, then a new one is blocked
BR-003: When an application is assessed, then the applicant must meet the eligibility of the type (adult types ≥ 21, Junior 5–20, Corporate: Singapore-registered company)
BR-004: When a request is submitted for approval, then every mandatory document of its type must be attached
BR-005: When a request is decided, then only an Approver (or the Manager where routed) may decide, and never the person who submitted it
BR-006: When a fee applies to an approved request, then it completes only after Finance confirms payment; a failed payment leaves it Awaiting Payment
BR-007: When an application is saved, then a recruitment source is required, and referrer details are required when the source is Referral
BR-008: When a renewal, conversion or extension would take combined Associate + Ordinary duration over 30 years (absent periods excluded), then it is blocked
BR-009: When a renewal is requested, then it must come from the member and the membership must be Active (or Absent / Medical)
BR-010: When Full converts to Basic, then remaining months × 2; when Basic converts to Full, then remaining months ÷ 2, rounded down
BR-011: When a transfer is requested, then the type must be transferable (Corporate is not) and the recipient must meet the type's eligibility
BR-012: When an extension is requested, then it may not exceed 24 months; ≤ 12 months goes to an Approver, > 12 months to the Manager
BR-013: When a withdrawal completes, then Finance must have cleared the balance, no refund of the remaining term is made, and the status becomes Withdrawn
BR-014: When the expiry date passes with no approved renewal, then the status becomes Expired; an approved rejoin reactivates with the original Membership ID
BR-015: When a deceased case proposes a goodwill refund, then only the Manager may approve it, and only then is it sent to Finance
BR-016: When an absent period is requested, then it must be 3–24 months and must not overlap an approved absent period; the term is suspended for it
BR-017: When a medical period is requested, then it may not exceed 12 months, and the expiry date is not changed
BR-018: When a status change is requested, then it is allowed only if the transition matrix permits it; a membership has exactly one current status
BR-019: When the status is Active, then privileges and billing are on; Absent / Medical: privileges off, billing per policy; Suspended: privileges off, billing on; other statuses: both off
BR-020: When a supplementary membership is created, then its principal must be Active; when the principal ends, the supplementary ends too
BR-021: When a junior member reaches 21, then junior eligibility ends; nothing converts automatically
BR-022: When a corporate nominee is assigned, then active nominees may not exceed the type's limit; a new corporate membership needs the Administrator

BR-023: When credit is checked, then available credit = In-House Credit Limit − Finance outstanding balance; if the Finance balance is unavailable, the check is blocked; Spending Credit Granted never changes
BR-024: When a vehicle is registered, then the membership must be Active and have fewer than 4 active vehicles
BR-025: When a card is issued, then the membership must be Active; the digital card is primary; a replacement voids the previous card
BR-026: When a marketing campaign is sent, then persons who withheld marketing consent are excluded; service correspondence is not affected
BR-027: When an active member's profile is saved, then mandatory fields (name, ID, date of birth, mobile, email, address) must be filled
BR-028: When a configuration value is referenced by a record, then it can be made inactive but not deleted
BR-029: When a request is approved, then its fee is read from the fee configuration of the type and event; no fee is requested before approval
BR-030: When a referred application completes, then a referral reward is raised only if an active referral campaign exists

BR-031: When a user opens the report catalogue or runs, exports or defines a report, then only the reports and data scope their role's access rule allows are offered; audit and workflow-history reports are restricted further
BR-032: When a report is run, then every required parameter must be given and valid, and the output is limited to the selected criteria
BR-033: When a report run matches no records, then a valid no-data result is shown without error; a run never changes a source record
BR-034: When a generated report is exported, then only a report designated for export may be, as Excel or PDF, with exactly the rows and scope shown on screen
BR-035: When a user-defined report is saved, then it builds on an approved report, cannot widen the role's data scope, and gets a new version with an effective date; earlier runs keep their version

BR-036: When a tee-sheet period is prepared, then tee times are generated per course (Changi, Kranji), day type and session from the configuration, and 9-hole play is allowed only in the weekday 07:01 – 07:57 period, never on weekend or public-holiday mornings
BR-037: When a tee time is booked online, then the request must fall inside the booking window and at least 2 hours before tee-off; staff-assisted booking may go later
BR-038: When a golfer is booked, then they hold no other session that day (an active waitlist entry counts); a second same-day 18-hole round needs Golf Manager approval with a reason

BR-039: When a flight is booked, then it has at most 4 golfers and at least 2 on weekdays or 3 on weekends and public holidays; a single golfer joins an existing flight instead of opening an invalid solo flight
BR-040: When a golfer uses member privileges, then their membership or nominee status from MMS must be Active with golf privilege; a suspended member cannot book or play
BR-041: When a Basic Member books, then they play weekdays independently, and on weekends only in a flight whose main booker is an eligible Full Member

BR-042: When guests are added, then the introducer is at least 18 and plays in the same flight, brings at most 3 guests, each guest holds a recognised handicap, and no guest plays at Changi on Saturday afternoon without approval

BR-043: When eligibility is checked, then on weekends and public holidays male HI ≤ 24.4 and female HI ≤ 36.4 play at any time; male 24.5 – 36.4, female 36.5 – 40.4 and NSRCC PC holders play weekdays or from 16:30; an external PC does not count

BR-044: When capacity is released, then it is offered first to the earliest waitlist entry whose party fits, held for 15 minutes; on decline or expiry the next entry gets it, and only then does it return to general availability

BR-045: When a booking is amended, then a player substitution carries the substitution fee, and a course change is allowed only with equivalent capacity at the other course and carries the course-change fee
BR-046: When a booking is cancelled with less than 72 hours' notice, then the late-cancellation charge (based on the course green fee) is raised on the booking member

BR-047: When an amendment, cancellation, no-show, fee or rain-check exception is waived or extended, then a Golf Manager approves it with a reason (and evidence where required); the requester cannot approve it
BR-048: When a golfer checks in, then it is at least 15 minutes before tee-off; later arrivals go to the late-arrival treatment

BR-049: When a golfer is released to play, then membership or guest eligibility, handicap or NSRCC PC, insurance (existing, annual or MSIG day insurance) and the 9 / 18-hole declaration are all satisfied, and the charge outcome is accepted
BR-050: When a guest claims a special rate without Guest Eligibility Proof, then the sign-in guest rate applies; proof produced within 7 working days allows an adjustment

BR-051: When a golfer is late, then they are rescheduled to a later free tee time if one exists, else joined by skipping holes if Golf Operations permits, else treated as a no-show with the no-show charge

BR-052: When a course is suspended or closed, then only the Club Captain, Vice-Captain, Golf Manager or an approved executive may do it; golfers who had not teed off get the green and buggy fee refund path, not a rain check
BR-053: When a qualifying suspension interrupts a golfer who has teed off before completing the first 9, or an 18-hole golfer who cannot cross over, then a 9-hole rain check is issued
BR-054: When a rain check is issued, then it is valid for 1 month, linked to the golfer, not transferable and has no cash value; an extension needs approval (BR-047)
BR-055: When a 9-hole rain check is applied to an 18-hole booking, then the golfer pays the top-up; a cheaper booking gives no residual refund

BR-056: When a handicap extract is imported, then it is staged and validated (identifier, gender, HI range) before it replaces the effective data; failing rows become exceptions and the prior values stay in history

BR-057: When capacity is blocked for maintenance, an HMS event, private use, a programme or management, then those tee times cannot be booked, keep their reason and source reference, and on release go to the waitlist first

BR-058: When golf charges are raised, then the rate comes from course, player category, 9 / 18 holes and day type, and every chargeable golfer has a responsible payer (member, introducing member for guests, corporate account, or self)

BR-059: When a golf charge is handed to Finance, then GMS keeps the Finance status (pending, accepted, rejected); member in-house credit needs Finance-derived eligibility (BR-023); GMS never stores a balance
BR-060: When a shift or day is closed, then counts and totals are compiled from GMS records, and unresolved exceptions and events without a Finance status stay flagged, never silently cleared

BR-084: When a page opens in a tab, then it renders only if the tab's role is one the page lists; otherwise it shows no content, and every link to a page the role cannot open is plain text, not a link
BR-085: When a Member tab reads member data, then it reads only its own account (membership, requests, golf bookings, rain checks, event registrations), set once from the launcher
BR-171: When an application or profile is saved, then the email must be a valid address and the mobile a Singapore number (+65, 8 digits, starting 8 or 9)
BR-172: When dates are entered, then the date of birth is not in the future, and a period's end date is after its start date
BR-173: When the first fee of a new or rejoining membership is confirmed paid in a month, then the membership starts on the 1st of the next month
BR-174: When a membership starts or is renewed, then its expiry = start date + the type's term in months (from configuration), moved out by approved absent months (BR-016)
BR-175: When a request is Submitted, then it is read-only until it is returned for correction or decided; only a Draft or Pending Documents request can be edited
BR-176: When a request is rejected or returned, then a reason is required

BR-177: When a material action happens (create, submit, decide, pay, apply, status change, configuration change), then a history entry records actor, role, time, from and to status, and comment; entries are never edited or deleted
BR-178: When a fee request is waiting at Payment pending in v01, then only an Approver may record payment through the labelled Finance stub; nothing marks a payment confirmed by itself

in: Golf: tee sheet setup and publication, golf booking in the Portal and at the counter, automated waitlist with 15-minute offers, amend and cancel with fees and the 72-hour rule, check-in and release to play, late arrival and no-show, course suspension and 9-hole rain checks, handicap extract and NSRCC PC records, tee capacity blocks, golf charges handed to the Finance stub, shift close, golfer enquiry
The 12 golf reports GMS-RR-001 to 012 in Club Reporting, on the live golf records
Membership and Club Reporting of v01 and v02, kept; the launcher shows Golf live with a Module details button on each live card, and four planned modules
out: Events, Facilities, Resorts and Finance screens (deferred to v04 to v07); the Finance side of golf charges is a stub
Balloting, PC Test, Courtesy Rounds, tournaments, buggy fleet, driving range, pace of play (not selected)
A live SGA handicap feed (a sample extract stands in), real payments, real e-mail and SMS
Real authentication and any server, API or database

constraints: Membership stays authoritative for member status, type and privileges; Golf only reads them
Golf never stores a balance; every charge has a responsible payer and a Finance status
The requester of a golf exception never approves it
Timers run on a fixed demo clock (Wed 28 Oct 2026 11:55)
Historical records are never physically deleted
Static site opened from file://, browser storage, invented data, Bootstrap 5.3.3 as the only library
